scope: Unit 3 of the common deployment experiment (handoff item 3): CE-6 (CE-R1 per live Server object, CE-C3 for every Server peer and Beacon owner, CE-R1' on NoBundleFailure runs) and CE-7 (CE-A2 over all accepts by mid-run report detection with one joint weak-EUF term per generated identity position, the NoBundleFailure signing-history lemma, CE-A2pub on NoBundleFailure runs).

commits.subject: Prove the live Server object consumes each registration ID once
Detect raw-accept origin failures by the report made at the accept
Bound accept-time Phase 1 forgeries over all accepts of the deployment experiment
Relate failed bundle calls to the owners' signing history
Bound published-tuple forgeries and replays on clean runs
Trace live record kernels through registration commands
Prove no record sequence is accepted twice in the deployment experiment
Describe the published-tuple module and reword a kernel note

exact_statements.PqxdhDeploymentAcceptDetection.forgery_b:
theorem forgery_bound (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (shortRejects : ∀ (publicKey : Ed25519PublicKey) bytes, bytes.length < 64 →
      setup.source.crypto.verify publicKey.toList bytes = none)
    (ensureInit : StateT A ProbComp Bool) (supplied : Option Pqxdh.Bytes) (count : Nat)
    (work : OracleComp (Spec KemSK) X) (runtime : A)
    (budget : PqxdhRegistrationJointRevealCosts.SourceKind → Nat)
    (certified : ∀ source, work.IsQueryBoundP
      (fun query => PqxdhRegistrationJointRevealCosts.sourceKind (KemSK := KemSK) query = source) (budget source))
    (capacity : (if supplied.isNone then 1 else 0) + budget (.inl 1) ≤ count + 1)
    (fallback : PqxdhDynamicIdentityRouting.DynamicForgery) (ordinaryFallback : PqxdhJointIdentity.Forgery) :
    letI := Classical.propDecidable
    𝒟[(fun final => decide (NativeForgery setup codec checks ensureInit supplied (count + 1) work runtime final)) <$>
      PqxdhJointPhase1Reports.run setup.joint (count + 1)
        (PqxdhRegistrationJointReportCompiler.initialized setup codec checks ensureInit supplied (count + 1) work
          runtime)] {true} ≤
      ∑ target : Fin (count + 1), PqxdhJointIdentity.advantage setup.joint
        (reduction setup codec checks ensureInit supplied count work runtime fallback ordinaryFallback target)

      PqxdhRegistrationJointServerPrefix.State KemSK A)

    (∀ kid, (peerSequences final.1.transcript kid).Nodup) ∧
      ∀ index, (ownerSequences final.1.transcript index).Nodup
exact_statements.PqxdhDeploymentRecordReplay.tracked_game:
theorem tracked_game (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (ensureInit : StateT A ProbComp Bool) (identityIndex : Nat)
    (bounds : FreshBounds) (mode : Mode) (adversary : OracleComp (ModeSpec mode) X) (runtime : A)
    (outcome : Option (PqxdhRegistrationJointServerBirth.ClientCreated Unit × X × PqxdhDeploymentSecrecy.State KemSK) ×
      A)
    (supported : outcome ∈ support ((PqxdhDeploymentSecrecy.game setup codec checks route ensureInit identityIndex
      bounds
      mode adversary).run runtime))
    (created : PqxdhRegistrationJointServerBirth.ClientCreated Unit) (output : X)
    (final : PqxdhDeploymentSecrecy.State KemSK) (reached : outcome.1 = some (created, output, final)) :
    Tracked setup.source.crypto final.1.transcript final.2

exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentReplay.registrationOf:
def registrationOf (crypto : Pqxdh.Crypto) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (raw : Pqxdh.Bytes) : Option Pqxdh.Bytes :=
  ((candidateOf codec raw).bind (acceptedKeys crypto)).map fun keys => keys.1.toList ++ keys.2.oneTime.toList
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentReplay.entryRegistration:
def entryRegistration (crypto : Pqxdh.Crypto) (codec : Codec Reader Response) : Entry → Option Pqxdh.Bytes
  | ⟨.inl (.inr (.accept raw)), some _⟩ => registrationOf crypto codec raw
  | _ => none
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentReplay.acceptIds:
def acceptIds (crypto : Pqxdh.Crypto) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (transcript : List Entry) : List Pqxdh.Bytes :=
  transcript.filterMap (entryRegistration crypto codec)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentReplay.Registered:
structure Registered (crypto : Pqxdh.Crypto) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (transcript : List Entry)
    (native : PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.State KemSK) : Prop where
  consumed : native.shared.2.server.consumed = acceptIds crypto codec transcript
  unique : (acceptIds crypto codec transcript).Nodup
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentAcceptDetection.upto:
noncomputable def upto (work : OracleComp (Spec KemSK) X) (index : Nat) : OracleComp (Spec KemSK) (Stop KemSK X) :=
  scan work index >>= stepAccept
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentAcceptDetection.Violation:
def ViolationAt (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks) {count : Nat}
    (stopped : ReportResult KemSK A (Stop KemSK X) count)
    (encoded : PqxdhRegistrationJointInitializedSchedule.Outcome KemSK (Stop KemSK X)) (raw : Pqxdh.Bytes)
    (session : Nat) (next : Option Nat → OracleComp (Spec KemSK) X)
    (value : PqxdhServerRootPreparation.Verified Reader) (address : Nat)
    (owner : PqxdhRegistrationJointGeneratedFinish.EncodedEntry) (target : Fin count) (publicKey : PublicIdentity) :
    Prop :=
  (sourceResult stopped).1 = some encoded ∧ encoded.2.1 = .accepted raw (some session) next ∧
    PqxdhRegistrationJointRawSignatures.verified setup codec checks raw = some value ∧
    encoded.2.2.owners[address]? = some owner ∧
    stopped.1.2.refs[owner.1]? = some (.generated target.val) ∧
    sourceKeys setup.joint (sourceResult stopped).2.1.1.seeds owner.1 = some publicKey ∧
    value.identity = publicKey.ed25519 ∧
    PqxdhRegistrationJointRoutedReveals.revealedAt owner.1 (sourceResult stopped).2.1.1.transcript = false ∧
    ¬PqxdhRegistrationJointAttemptDecoding.Occurred value.keys
      (PqxdhRegistrationJointSigningTranscript.messagesAt owner.1 (sourceResult stopped).2.1.1.transcript)

def Violation (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks) {count : Nat}
    (stopped : ReportResult KemSK A (Stop KemSK X) count) : Prop :=
  ∃ encoded raw session next value address owner target publicKey,
    ViolationAt setup codec checks stopped encoded raw session next value address owner target publicKey
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentAcceptDetection.NativeFor:
def NativeForgery (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (ensureInit : StateT A ProbComp Bool) (supplied : Option Pqxdh.Bytes) (count : Nat)
    (work : OracleComp (Spec KemSK) X) (runtime : A) (final : ReportResult KemSK A X count) : Prop :=
  ∃ (index : Nat) (stopped : ReportResult KemSK A (Stop KemSK X) count),
    stopped ∈ support (PqxdhJointPhase1Reports.run setup.joint count
      (PqxdhRegistrationJointReportCompiler.initialized setup codec checks ensureInit supplied count (upto work index)
        runtime)) ∧
    final ∈ support (continuation setup codec checks ensureInit count resumeStop stopped) ∧
    Violation setup codec checks stopped
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentProvenance.client:
noncomputable def client (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (ensureInit : StateT A ProbComp Bool) (bounds : FreshBounds)
    (mode : Mode) (adversary : OracleComp (ModeSpec mode) X) (count : Nat) (runtime : A) :
    OracleComp ProtocolSpec ((Option (PqxdhRegistrationJointOpenInitialization.Outcome KemSK ((X × Ledger) × Local)) ×
      PqxdhRegistrationJointIdentityCompiler.Local KemSK A) × PqxdhRegistrationJointIdentityRouting.Registry) := do
  let output ← PqxdhRegistrationJointReportCompiler.initialized setup codec checks ensureInit none count
    (compileFull setup codec route bounds mode adversary) runtime
  announceAll count (acceptedCandidates codec (finalTranscript output))
  pure output
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentProvenance.reduction:
noncomputable def reduction (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (checks : Checks)
    (route : RawCtxServerRouting.SenderDecoder) (ensureInit : StateT A ProbComp Bool) (bounds : FreshBounds)
    (mode : Mode) (adversary : OracleComp (ModeSpec mode) X) (count : Nat) (runtime : A)
    (fallback : PqxdhDynamicIdentityRouting.DynamicForgery) (ordinaryFallback : PqxdhJointIdentity.Forgery)
    (target : Fin (count + 1)) :=
  PqxdhJointIdentityFreshness.globalReduction setup.joint target ordinaryFallback
    (PqxdhDynamicIdentityRouting.routedAdversary count ordinaryFallback
      (PqxdhDynamicIdentityReports.reportExtractor setup.joint (count + 1) fallback
        (PqxdhJointPhase1Reports.routedClient setup.joint (count + 1)
          (client setup codec checks route ensureInit bounds mode adversary (count + 1) runtime))))
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentSigningHistory.History:
def History (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (transcript : List PqxdhDeploymentInterface.Entry)
    (owner : Nat) (entry : PqxdhRegistrationJointOwnership.Entry KemSK) (pool : PqxdhDynamicIdentityPool.SourceState) :
    Prop :=
  (PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.phase transcript owner = .fresh ∧ PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.bundleOf transcript owner = none ∧
      messagesAt entry.identityIndex pool.transcript = []) ∨
    (PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.phase transcript owner ≠ .fresh ∧
      ∃ bytes keys, PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.bundleOf transcript owner = some bytes ∧
        codec.write1 (PqxdhJointPhase1SourceWriter.signedCandidate setup.joint entry.owner.beacon.identity
          (setup.joint.publicKeys entry.owner.beacon.identity).ed25519 keys) = some bytes ∧
        messagesAt entry.identityIndex pool.transcript = PqxdhRegistrationJointIssuedAttempts.messages keys)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentSigningHistory.Signed:
structure Signed (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response) (server : RawCtxServerRouting.Identity)
    (transcript : List PqxdhDeploymentInterface.Entry) (state : PqxdhRegistrationJointSchedule.State KemSK) : Prop where
  agree : PqxdhDeploymentEligibility.Agree setup codec server transcript (PqxdhRegistrationJointSchedule.source state)
  owned : PqxdhRegistrationJointSchedule.Invariant state
  distinct : ∀ (first second : Nat) (firstEntry secondEntry : PqxdhRegistrationJointOwnership.Entry KemSK),
    state.owners[first]? = some firstEntry → state.owners[second]? = some secondEntry →
      firstEntry.identityIndex = secondEntry.identityIndex → first = second
  future : ∀ index, state.pool.1.seeds.length ≤ index → messagesAt index state.pool.1.transcript = []
  absent : ∀ owner, state.owners.length ≤ owner →
    (PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.summarize transcript).failures owner = false ∧
      PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.bundleOf transcript owner = none
  history : ∀ owner (entry : PqxdhRegistrationJointOwnership.Entry KemSK), state.owners[owner]? = some entry →
    (PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.summarize transcript).failures owner = false →
      History setup codec transcript owner entry state.pool.1
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentPublishedTuple.candidateT:
def candidateTuple (candidate : PqxdhEd25519EufCma.Phase1Candidate) : Option PqxdhEd25519EufCma.Phase1KeyTuple := do
  let pre ← PqxdhEd25519EufCma.splitAttachedSignature candidate.preKey
  let one ← PqxdhEd25519EufCma.splitAttachedSignature candidate.oneTimeKey
  let pq ← PqxdhEd25519EufCma.splitAttachedSignature candidate.pqKey
  let prekey ← PqxdhEd25519EufCma.parsePrekeyMessage pre.2
  let oneTime ← PqxdhEd25519EufCma.parseOneTimeMessage one.2
  let pqKey ← PqxdhEd25519EufCma.parsePqMessage pq.2
  pure ⟨prekey, oneTime, pqKey⟩
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentPublishedTuple.publishedT:
def publishedTuple (codec : Codec Reader Response) (transcript : List PqxdhDeploymentInterface.Entry) (owner : Nat) :
    Option PqxdhEd25519EufCma.Phase1KeyTuple :=
  ((PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.bundleOf transcript owner).bind (PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.candidateOf codec)).bind
    candidateTuple
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentPublishedTuple.PublishedF:
def PublishedForgery (crypto : Pqxdh.Crypto) (codec : Codec Reader Response)
    (transcript : List PqxdhDeploymentInterface.Entry) (identities : List PqxdhEd25519EufCma.Ed25519PublicKey) : Prop :=
  ∃ (raw : Pqxdh.Bytes) (session : Nat),
    (⟨.inl (.inr (.accept raw)), some session⟩ : PqxdhDeploymentInterface.Entry) ∈ transcript ∧
    ∃ candidate identity decoded owner, PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.candidateOf codec raw = some candidate ∧
      PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.acceptedKeys crypto candidate = some (identity, decoded) ∧
      identities[owner]? = some identity ∧ publishedTuple codec transcript owner ≠ some decoded
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentPublishedTuple.GameEvent:
def GameEvent (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response)
    (outcome : Option (PqxdhRegistrationJointServerBirth.ClientCreated Unit × X × PqxdhDeploymentSecrecy.State KemSK) × A) :
    Prop :=
  ∃ created output final, outcome.1 = some (created, output, final) ∧
    PublishedForgery setup.source.crypto codec final.1.transcript (ownerIdentities setup final.2.native) ∧
    PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.NoBundleFailure final.1.transcript
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentPublishedTuple.DoubleAcce:
def DoubleAccept (crypto : Pqxdh.Crypto) (codec : Codec Reader Response)
    (transcript : List PqxdhDeploymentInterface.Entry) (identities : List PqxdhEd25519EufCma.Ed25519PublicKey) : Prop :=
  ∃ (first second : Nat), first ≠ second ∧
    ∃ (raw raw' : Pqxdh.Bytes) (session session' : Nat) (candidate candidate' : PqxdhEd25519EufCma.Phase1Candidate)
      (identity : PqxdhEd25519EufCma.Ed25519PublicKey) (keys keys' : PqxdhEd25519EufCma.Phase1KeyTuple) (owner : Nat),
      transcript[first]? = some ⟨.inl (.inr (.accept raw)), some session⟩ ∧
      transcript[second]? = some ⟨.inl (.inr (.accept raw')), some session'⟩ ∧
      PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.candidateOf codec raw = some candidate ∧
      PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.candidateOf codec raw' = some candidate' ∧
      PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.acceptedKeys crypto candidate = some (identity, keys) ∧
      PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.acceptedKeys crypto candidate' = some (identity, keys') ∧
      identities[owner]? = some identity
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentPublishedTuple.ReplayEven:
def ReplayEvent (setup : Setup baseSpec KemSK) (codec : Codec Reader Response)
    (outcome : Option (PqxdhRegistrationJointServerBirth.ClientCreated Unit × X × PqxdhDeploymentSecrecy.State KemSK) × A) :
    Prop :=
  ∃ created output final, outcome.1 = some (created, output, final) ∧
    DoubleAccept setup.source.crypto codec final.1.transcript (ownerIdentities setup final.2.native) ∧
    PqxdhDeploymentTranscript.NoBundleFailure final.1.transcript
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentRecordKernels.Live:
def Live (c : Pqxdh.Crypto) (kernel : ConcreteRatchetKernel) : Prop :=
  ∃ sendOrigin receiveOrigin, RawCtxReceiveConsumption.ConsumedRefines c sendOrigin receiveOrigin kernel []
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentRecordKernels.Finished:
def Finished (c : Pqxdh.Crypto) (kernel : ConcreteRatchetKernel) : Prop :=
  ∃ sendOrigin receiveOrigin, RawCtxReceiveConsumption.ConsumedRefines c sendOrigin receiveOrigin kernel [0]
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentRecordKernels.OwnersSame:
def OwnersSame (before after : List (PqxdhRegistrationSchedule.Owner KemSK)) : Prop :=
  ∀ index : Nat, ownerKernel after[index]? = ownerKernel before[index]?
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentRecordReplay.peerAccepted:
def peerAccepted (kid : Std.U64) : Entry → Option Std.U64
  | ⟨.inl (.inr (.serverRaw _)), .Some message⟩ => if message.keyId = kid then some message.sequence else none
  | _ => none
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentRecordReplay.ownerAccepte:
def ownerAccepted (index : Nat) : Entry → Option Std.U64
  | ⟨.inl (.inr (.beaconRaw owner _)), .Some message⟩ => if owner = index then some message.sequence else none
  | ⟨.inl (.inr (.finish owner _)), some _⟩ => if owner = index then some 1#u64 else none
  | _ => none
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentRecordReplay.peerSequence:
def peerSequences (transcript : List Entry) (kid : Std.U64) : List Std.U64 :=
  transcript.filterMap (peerAccepted kid)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentRecordReplay.ownerSequenc:
def ownerSequences (transcript : List Entry) (index : Nat) : List Std.U64 :=
  transcript.filterMap (ownerAccepted index)
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentRecordReplay.Holds:
def Holds (c : Pqxdh.Crypto) (kernel : Option ConcreteRatchetKernel) (sequences : List Std.U64) : Prop :=
  match kernel with
  | some kernel => ∃ sendOrigin receiveOrigin,
      RawCtxReceiveConsumption.ConsumedRefines c sendOrigin receiveOrigin kernel (positions sequences)
  | none => sequences = []
exact_definitions.PqxdhDeploymentRecordReplay.Tracked:
structure Tracked (c : Pqxdh.Crypto) (transcript : List Entry) (state : PqxdhDeploymentNative.State KemSK) : Prop where
  peers : ∀ kid, Holds c (peerKernel state.native.shared.2.server.server kid) (peerSequences transcript kid)
  owners : ∀ index, Holds c (ownerKernel state.native.owners[index]?) (ownerSequences transcript index)

leanpath.note: The unit A LEAN_PATH with its first entry replaced by the fresh scratch prefix unit3/olean, a symlink mirror of the unit A artifacts (1543 links, every deployment artifact verified against the d42c4d3d sources); check.py unlinks an artifact before writing it, so unit A files were never written. After the last source change the seven unit 3 modules were rebuilt into unit3/olean in import order (direct_check_final).

focused_inventory_note: Each module commit was prepared with the other untracked files and other modified tracked files held aside and restored afterwards (commit.py), so check-inventory ran with exactly the files of that commit. Entries are keyed by the first module of a commit, so for modules committed more than once they record the latest run. The documentation commit that adds this receipt is checked the same way.
forbidden_scan: zero matches of \b(sorry|admit|native_decide|implemented_by|extern|unsafe|opaque)\b and no axiom declaration in the seven modules; the only set_option lines are autoImplicit false and linter.deprecated false scoped by in to single theorems
deviations_from_plan: CE-A2 is proved by mid-run detection (PqxdhDeploymentAcceptDetection.upto stops the program right after the selected raw accept; the stopped run ends with that accept's own report batch; upto_detects, violation_detects through AttemptReports.owner_origin), so there is no selection factor and no collision term; the per-ordinal fallback was not needed.

The CE-A2 event NativeForgery is a reachability event on final outcomes (some run through a violating accept reaches the outcome); it contains the path event, so the bound is only stronger. The violation is read in the state reached when the accept returned.

CE-A2 is stated on the report-instrumented initialized execution of compileFull with a generated Server seed, because its event refers to the private signing log, reveal history and identity handles; report_game identifies the projection (created, output, ledger) with the deployment game at Server identity index 0. CE-A2pub and CE-R1' are stated on the deployment game itself, at Server identity index 0 (the index compile_full_source assigns from empty pools).

The A2 client is the instrumented execution followed by one terminal public batch per successful accept of the final transcript (announceAll); the batches add no identity request (client_creates), so CE-A2, CE-A2pub and CE-R1' share one reduction family and one sum.

CE-A2pub compares key tuples (verified tuple against the tuple parsed from the published bundle without a signature check); no SUF-CMA or signature uniqueness is used. Owner identity keys are read from the native owners (ownerIdentities).
CE-R1' is derived deterministically from CE-R1 (replay_published) and bounded by the CE-A2pub bound, not twice it.

CE-C3 uses RawCtxReceiveConsumption.ConsumedRefines (raw_spent, send_spent, initialized-kernel relations) over transcript-derived accepted positions rather than the HB-105 private history monitor. The owner side includes the successful finish's acceptance of sequence one, which is stronger than a raw-receive-only reading. Peers are separated by the key ID named by the decrypted record, which is the routed key ID (rawGame_success).
No planned statement turned out false or unprovable and no statement was weakened.
contracts_used: CE-R1, CE-C3, the signing-history lemma and the detection lemma use no codec law. CE-A2 uses the existing shortRejects format rule with setup.wiring and the budget. CE-A2pub and CE-R1' add the approved Phase1ReadBack and Phase2ReadBack. FrameReadBack and DecoderAgreement are not used. Supplied Server seed is none in every security statement.
not_proved: CE-A2pub and CE-R1' on runs with a failed bundle call in Fresh (out of scope by design).
Replay across Server objects, copies, restorations or persistence (CE-M, R4).
A run-level witness that the replay and provenance events are reachable.
CE-8 onwards: the A1 embedding, the per-target KEM transfer (including KeyMatchFinal), CE-9b, item 2 joins, the un-compiled ideal world, the headlines.
re_estimate: CE-9 lowered from 5-10 to 3-7 agent-days because the Signed invariant pattern over the stacked execution carries over to the bundle-to-KEM-pool invariant; item 3 proper without CE-9b, CE-10 and CE-12 about 26-48 agent-days remaining.
checks_not_run: No lake build, make verify, nix-collect-garbage, mutation testing, ProVerif or Rust run; no production Rust or ProVerif change.
